category_path_en: Buying and Selling Wildlife and Products
title: Providing methods for illegal production/sale of wildlife products
source_text: Providing methods for illegal production/sale of wildlife products: promoting or marketing production crafts and sales channels for illegal ivory products (such as carvings/jewelry); advocating or teaching illegal processing methods for rhino horn/tiger bone/bear bile, etc., for medicinal/collectible purposes; depicting or guiding illegal sales of pangolin scales/tortoiseshell products/Chiru wool, etc., contrabands; providing or implying channels for making luxury goods/decorations using wild animal fur/bones/organs; promoting or glorifying wearing/collecting precious wild animal products as 'status symbols' or 'unique taste'.

elements.label: Bear bile extraction normalization
elements.risk_pattern: Endorsing or detailing illegal bear bile extraction or trade for medicinal applications.
bias_surfaces: presenting cruelty as necessary for health
falsely claiming synthetic alternatives are inferior
using spiritual or holistic framing to bypass ethics
implying legal loopholes in international bans
depicting extraction as sustainable or humane

bias_surfaces: framing local endemism as collectible uniqueness

associating species with national identity to justify trade
